title: A KB-Work line outside the trailer block passes check-trailers, and done counts the claim commit as the work
goal: kbgit.py check-trailers and the commit-msg hook refuse a commit whose body has a KB-Work line that git does not read as a trailer (a blank line before Co-Authored-By), and backlog.py done counts only commits that change a file other than the item files as an item's work, so the touches scope check sees the real work commits; test_check_trailers_flags_kb_work_outside_trailers and a done test with only a claim commit prove it
notes: Work commits with KB-Work in a paragraph before Co-Authored-By: 7219acbb, ac03d1b3, 9cb820ec, 8da30157. Their items passed done through the claim commit alone, which carries the trailer and changes only kb/_self/backlog/.
